facts.note: East to west across the whole site, crag and approach together.
From the shrine on the valley floor to the bell tower at the castle's north edge.
The crag top the castle stands on: sixteen blocks over the valley floor, so the castle towers over the approach.
How far the causeway tower climbs from the valley floor to the bridge deck: high enough to read as a bridge, short of a killing fall.
The bell deck, the highest place a body stands; seen from the causeway.
The outer ward, the hub every region opens from.
The pilgrim road's run before it climbs: the walk in is long enough to look at the castle.
The undercroft floor, twelve below the castle, inside the crag.
